_comment: The same run against a HubSpot-as-CRM portal. Record shapes are HubSpot's ({id, properties}), the canonical files Claude writes (interactions, sentiment, company_research) are identical to the Salesforce fixture. Nothing in analyze.py branches on CRM vendor.

sources.name: customer_accounts
sources.diagnosis: Zero companies means lifecyclestage is not the property this portal uses to mark customers, or the private-app token is missing the crm.objects.companies.read scope.

sources.name: renewals
sources.note: Verdant Foods has no renewal deal and no renewal_date property — the run reports it as unmeasurable rather than low risk.

sources.name: crm_activities
sources.query: POST /crm/v3/objects/calls/search and /emails/search and /meetings/search, filtered on hs_timestamp >= window start and the associated company id

sources.name: interactions
sources.note: This portal has no conversation-intelligence tool. Transcripts come from an exported folder and threads from the mailbox — the documented no-recorder path.
sources.diagnosis: If the transcript folder returns nothing, check the folder path in config and that the files are .txt/.md/.vtt rather than a proprietary export format.

sources.name: sentiment_readings
sources.note: Two of three accounts have a conversation source. Verdant Foods has none.

sources.name: support_tickets
sources.diagnosis: No support source configured. The support-burden signal is dropped and its weight redistributed.

sources.name: product_usage
sources.diagnosis: No product-usage source configured. The usage signal is dropped and its weight redistributed.

warnings: Verdant Foods has neither a renewal deal nor a renewal_date property. The heaviest signal in the model cannot be computed for it.
This portal has no support desk and no usage feed connected. Two of ten commercial signals are unavailable across the whole book.
